hypotheses.assumptions: predictions from the bmm rules found on PyTorch 2.14.0; they assume PyTorch's bmm backward formulas grad_self = grad @ mat2^T, grad_mat2 = self^T @ grad (transposed views) and that matmul's batch folding copies Q/K/V into contiguous 3-D tensors
hypotheses.eager_2p31_to_2p32: 2^31 <= B*H*L^2 <= 2^32 (683 <= B <= 1365): forward correct; backward raises (rule 2 on P^T, a view with >= 2^31 elements, in the gradient of V for softmax(S)V)
hypotheses.eager_above_2p32: B*H*L^2 > 2^32 (B >= 1366): forward wrong for texts from 1365 (head 4) on (rule 3 on P); backward raises (rule 2); grad_P = dO V^T would fall under rule 1 if reached
hypotheses.eager_ffn: FFN intermediate (B*L, 3072) >= 2^31 from B = 1366: the FFN's 2-D matmuls (not covered by the bmm rules) have views >= 2^31 in backward and may raise or abort first; autograd reaches layer 11's FFN before its attention, so the anomaly trace is needed to tell which op failed
hypotheses.sdpa: unknown (inference: dispatched to aten::_scaled_dot_product_attention_math_for_mps, forward correct).
